story: AURORA-AI — a UAF-led DOE Genesis Mission award for Alaska utility resilience, unreported by anyone

claims.text: The DOE Office of Science Genesis Mission Phase I awards list, posted 2026-07-22, includes an award to Richard Wies of the University of Alaska Fairbanks titled 'AURORA-AI: Alaska Utility Resilience & Optimization using Real-time AI'.
claims.verbatim: Wies, Richard | AURORA-AI: Alaska Utility Resilience & Optimization using Real-time AI | University of Alaska Fairbanks | Fairbanks | AK | 99775-7880
claims.source_name: DOE Office of Science, Genesis Mission RFA awards list (announcement DE-FOA-0003612)

claims.text: The National Laboratory of the Rockies lists AURORA-AI among the projects it supports, led by the University of Alaska Fairbanks.
claims.verbatim: AURORA-AI: Alaska Utility Resilience and Optimization Using Real-Time AI -- Led by University of Alaska Fairbanks

claims.text: Nothing published anywhere describes what AURORA-AI will actually do. No abstract, no method, no named utility, no dollar figure, no timeline. The press release points readers to a webpage that lists only the title.
claims.source_name: National Laboratory of the Rockies press release
claims.note: This absence is itself verified: the release, its GlobeNewswire twin, the NLR Genesis Mission page and energy.gov were all fetched and none goes beyond the title.

claims.text: The Genesis Mission is a DOE initiative launched 2025-11-24 that combines AI, supercomputing and quantum systems into one science-discovery platform. DOE announced 293 million dollars in March 2026 and more than 800 million dollars in partner commitments in July 2026.

Cordova Electric Cooperative's microgrid, serving a town of about 2,600 residents, was rebuilt as a real-time digital twin on the national lab's ARIES platform under the RADIANCE project, a 6.2 million dollar DOE grant, including about 1,200 smart meters, 6 phasor measurement units and a 1 MW battery.
claims.source_name: National Laboratory of the Rockies (then NREL)
claims.note: SEPARATE, EARLIER PROJECT. No source links RADIANCE to AURORA-AI. Any on-screen use must not imply they are the same project.

claims.text: In March 2026 a 170 kW modular data center was installed inside Cordova's Humpback Creek hydroelectric plant, using surplus hydropower for local computing.
claims.note: SEPARATE from AURORA-AI. Same caveat as C5.

claims.text: The National Laboratory of the Rockies has a Fairbanks campus and describes it as the only national lab based in Alaska. NREL was renamed the National Laboratory of the Rockies in December 2025.
Richard Wies is a professor of electrical and computer engineering at UAF, on the faculty since August 1999, researching distributed generation, load control and microgrids.
claims.note: Secondary sourcing only. Needs a uaf.edu confirmation before any on-screen biographical claim.

claims.text: No Alaska news outlet, and not UAF or ACEP themselves, has published anything about this award as of 2026-07-29.
claims.source_name: Direct checks of adn.com, alaskapublic.org, ktoo.org, uaf.edu news and the ACEP site
claims.note: alaskabeacon.com returned 403 and the Fairbanks Daily News-Miner hit a rate limit, so those two are UNCHECKED rather than confirmed absent. Phrase on screen as 'no coverage we could find', never as an absolute.

fact_check_status: VERIFIED — every load-bearing claim re-fetched independently by a second agent on 2026-07-29
on_screen_rules: C8 (Wies biography) is SECONDARY-sourced only. Do not put a biographical claim on screen. He may be named as the principal investigator, which is primary-sourced from the DOE awards list.
C5 and C6 (Cordova) are a SEPARATE, EARLIER project. The film must never imply Cordova is what AURORA-AI funds. Label it on screen as a different project.
C9 must be phrased as 'no coverage we could find', never as an absolute, because two outlets could not be checked.
No dollar figure may be attached to AURORA-AI. The programme-wide range is NOT this award's number.
Numbers on screen are illustrative where drawn as objects; the figures themselves come only from this file.
